question: Which distinct attainments are being grouped here as results associated with the instruction addressed to the goddess?
premises: Deception of time is named as one item.
Immortality and poetic power are joined by connective to the same list.
The address frames all three as items of instruction.
inference: Deception of time, immortality, and poetic power are grouped as attainments in this instruction.
uncertainties: The means to any of these three is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: O goddess, deception of time, and immortality and poetic power.
